requirements.label: IDE degrees: general six credits versus programme-specific counts
requirements.details: General page 13 requires six C-or-better school passes including English C. IDE Commerce and Humanities instead print six passes with five C grades, while IDE LLB prints six passes with English C and at least four C subjects; Information Science lists at least four other C subjects plus the General Regulations. The source does not establish an approved lower-sixth-grade exception or a waiver of English. Keep both statements and confirm the applicable count; the conventional Science faculty's English D wording is not an IDE English exemption.

requirements.label: Named IDE degree mature-entry framework
requirements.details: Where the IDE sections offer mature entry for Commerce, Primary/Secondary Education, Humanities, LLB, Information Science, IT or Computer Science Education, they refer to the Academic General Regulations. General page 13 describes applicants over 22 who do not meet normal requirements; programme-specific conditions still apply and scheme details are available on request. This is over 22, not automatically age 22 inclusive or a new work-duration rule. It is not a mature-entry waiver of the Nursing Completion diploma/registration requirements.

requirements.label: Psychosocial Support certificate: two qualification options
requirements.details: The IDE Certificate in Psychosocial Support lists Junior Certificate or recognized equivalent with at least four subject passes including English, OR EGCSE/SGCSE/IGCSE/GCE O-level or recognized equivalent with three passes including English Language. requirements.label: Diploma in Law: school-certificate option
requirements.details: The IDE school-certificate option states six SGCSE/IGCSE/equivalent passes at E or better, including C or better in English and at least three other subjects. This is followed by OR-separated qualification/mature alternatives. The six-E/four-C wording differs from general page 13's six-C diploma baseline; no automatic exception is promised. The 381 credits elsewhere on this page concern the diploma curriculum, not credits needed before applying.

requirements.label: Named IDE certificates/diploma versus general school-pass rules
requirements.details: General page 13 gives certificate entry as four passes with English at least E and diploma entry as six C-or-better passes including English and three other relevant subjects. IDE Portuguese names Junior Certificate, Psychosocial Support has a three-pass school-certificate alternative, and Diploma in Law permits six E-or-better passes with English/three others at C. The special/general relationship is not expressly settled; confirm each named route rather than silently imposing or waiving a different scheme's rule.

requirements.label: IDE Commerce: distinct diploma entry levels

These are distinct qualification routes, not a promise that every business diploma gives Level 4.

requirements.label: IDE Primary Science: school-subject science alternatives
requirements.details: For the Science specialization, SGCSE/IGCSE/equivalent requires C or better in Mathematics, two from Biology, Chemistry, Life Sciences, Physical Science or Physics OR Co-ordinated Sciences (expressly counts as two), plus another subject. For GCE O-level/COSC/equivalent, the listed sciences are Biology, Chemistry, Physics, Science (Chemistry/Physics), OR Combined Science with Additional Combined Science, plus Mathematics and another subject. These are qualification-specific science alternatives, read with the General Regulations.
